title: Specified etale to pro-etale exceptional Hom transport and counit compatibility
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $i:Z\to T$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $T$ quasi-compact. Use ordinary constant-$A$ etale and pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with $C_W=\nu_W^*$ the exact derived comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Write $F_e=Ri_{e,*}$ and $F_p=Ri_{p,*}$ for ordinary derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Use the existing etale exceptional adjoint $G_e=i^\times$, normalized to $F_e\dashv G_e$ by the canonical proper forget-supports comparison for the identity-open compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Put $G_p=C_ZG_eR\nu_{T,*}$, exactly the finite exceptional formula [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Define $b:C_TF_e\to F_pC_Z$ to be the adjunction mate of the canonical ordinary pullback square, using the exact/left-derived identifications; its definition includes the ordinary pullback/direct-image counit normalization.

For $H\in D^+(Z_e,A)$ and $L\in D^+(T_p,A)$ define the map
$$h_{H,L}:\operatorname{Hom}(F_pC_ZH,L)\to\operatorname{Hom}(C_ZH,G_pL)$$
by first precomposing with $b_H$, then applying the comparison adjunction, then the ordinary exceptional adjunction, then applying $C_Z$ to the resulting morphism. This definition asserts no bijectivity. For $N\in D^+(T_e,A)$ let $j_N:N\to R\nu_{T,*}C_TN$ be the actual comparison unit and let $o_N=C_ZG_e(j_N):C_ZG_eN\to G_pC_TN$. The existing bounded-below exceptional interface supplies $G_eN\in D^+(Z_e,A)$.

Define $\operatorname{CounitComparison}_i(N)$ to mean that $o_N$ is invertible, that the canonical component $b_{G_eN}$ is an isomorphism, and that there is a morphism $\mu:F_pC_ZG_eN\to C_TN$ with
$$h_{G_eN,C_TN}(\mu)=o_N,\qquad \mu=C_T(\varepsilon^e_N)\circ b_{G_eN}^{-1},$$
where $\varepsilon^e$ is the counit of the specified normalized etale exceptional adjunction. Equivalently the isomorphism used here must have hom exactly the canonical mate component. These are definitions of the Hom map, origin map and compatibility property, not an existence assertion for an ambient pro-etale exceptional adjunction.
